protocol.armOrder: deterministic round-robin rotation by repetition; no tuning
protocol.timing: login + facts + immutable provenance + serialization validation + logout; response bodies measured by clone in every arm
protocol.scope: local HTTP/context assembly only; excludes model prefill, generation and judge

ingestion.measurement: Application-role source writes and candidate+approval transactions; schema initialization excluded; database size is page-allocation proxy, not per-index marginal storage.

bootstrap.estimand: query-weighted mean; resample scopes with replacement
bootstrap.warning: Few scopes; descriptive exploratory CIs, not evidence of answer-quality noninferiority

offline_retrieval.evidence_policy: distinct original literal references; unresolved count as misses; no repair; empty evidence is N/A; resolved_* uses only resolvable references and has separate denominators
